procurement_findings.basis: Both source offer sets together match all26 exact selected MPNs with positive available stock exceeding one-board population on2026-11-23/24. No substitution required beyond already adopted A4 corrections. Pack quantities and final price/shipping remain purchasing checks, not inferred guarantees.

Eight remaining current minima confirmed on exact live DigiKey pages24November2026. MOR is MOQ/multiple10, all other25 MPNs MOQ1. One board populates30 parts, purchases39 individual parts before optional spares.

freshness_policy: All26 exact selected stock offers and pack minima are live parent read-only browser observations on stated dates. U1 stock observed23November2026; other25 stock offers and final eight MOQ checks24November2026. Inventory is not reserved and can change. Five TME live prices and all shipping remain unquoted.
